We have asked the landlord directly and will come back to you as soon as we have their answer. Please also confirm whether your quote of £220 / £240 / £100 / £45 includes VAT.

Flat 21, 11 Juniper Mews: the contractor says you OK'd his quote by phone. We need it from you in writing.
